gloss: if that's the case; if it is; then

definitions.gloss: if that's the case; if it is; in that case
definitions.explanation: Casual conditional expression formed from だった (past of だ) plus ら. Follows nouns and na-adjective stems. Often used as a discourse connector meaning 'in that case' or 'if so', and can open a new clause in response to something just said.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧だったら⟦{知|し}っ→知る：00458_shiru⟧てる⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
そうだったら、⟦もっと→もっと：00798_motto⟧⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧⟦{言|い}って→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
examples.english: If that's the case, you should have said so sooner.
If you're free, want to go see a movie or something?

notes:
Casual conditional form of the copula だ, equivalent to 'if it is ~' or 'if that's the case'. Follows nouns and na-adjective stems directly.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- Xだったら〜 — if X is the case/if it is X
- そうだったら〜 — if that's so
- 〜んだったら〜 — if (the situation is that) ~

SIMILAR WORDS:
- なら: similar conditional meaning but slightly more formal/neutral; can also follow verb/i-adj directly
- だとしたら: more formal equivalent, 'if it is the case that'
